description: Generates CS 454 assessment load combinations with the plugin's engine (Table A.1 γfL by combination 1–4 and limit state, adverse/relieving permanent variants, wind sub-case, ALL/SV/HB traffic with associated traffic, exclusive groups collapsed into envelopes, readable names) and writes them to an LCOM table with its commit; every row is read back by name. Previews unless apply: true.

cases.description: Per-case mapping edits (match by caseId or caseName, as cs454_combinations_read lists them).

action.description: A Table A.1 action key (static) or a moving action (TRAFFIC_NORMAL, TRAFFIC_ASSOCIATED, TRAFFIC_ABNORMAL_SV, TRAFFIC_ABNORMAL_HB, FOOTWAY, ACCIDENTAL_VEHICLE).

gammaFL.description: Moving cases without Auto Live Load Combination only: replaces the Table A.1 γfL for that case.

model.description: Moving: CS 454 load model key (cs454_combinations_read options.loadModels).

collapse.description: Combine exclusive groups into one envelope sub-combination (the plugin's default); false never collapses.

existingHandling.description: Required when the target already holds combinations. Deleting only with the user's agreement.

includeEnvelopes.description: Also write one envelope per family (General only).

customActions.description: User-defined variable actions (become X_<NAME>, factors 1.00/0.00 until edited).

groups.description: null = automatic from the mapping; "template:<id>" (see options.groupTemplates); or the full { groups, withinCategory, constraints } state.

scope.description: Combinations 1–4, each { uls, sls }. Default: c1 ULS+SLS, c2–c4 ULS.

show.description: Which combinations to list in the preview (all are written).

structureType.description: Table A.1 general or cast iron (ULS only); masonry arches are out of scope (blocked).

name: cs454_combinations_apply
title: Generate and write CS 454 assessment combinations
